report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
Adds Java Redis semantic-convention conformance for Jedis, Lettuce, Rediscala, and Redisson. All four clients run through the OpenTelemetry Java agent, and Lettuce also runs through the standalone `opentelemetry-lettuce-5.1` instrumentation.

The scenarios cover reads, writes, pipelines or transactions, and `WRONGTYPE` failures against Redis 8.2.1. Contracts classify spans as `db.redis.client` and record each client's emitted attributes.

### Known instrumentation gaps

Jedis does not mark rejected `LPUSH` spans as errors. Rediscala does not emit `db.namespace` or `db.query.text`.
metadata.title: Add Java Redis client conformance
